newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BellSouth launches NZ caller ID service.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth launches NZ caller ID service.

text.p: BellSouth said on Wednesday it would launch New Zealand's first commercial caller identification service on Friday.
The service would initially operate only for calls between two phones on the BellSouth network where the phone number of the caller would appear on the screen of the receiving customer's phone.
When the service is turned on for the landline network, those numbers would also be displayed on BellSouth's customer phone screens.
BellSouth said privacy concerns had been averted by allowing customers to choose whether to have their numbers displayed.
